static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.family_status: Both parents serve in the military
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive girlfriend and friends, but they do not fully understand the fear of spiders; this fear causes tension in the intimate relationship; work performance not yet affected; home and outdoor leisure affected
static_traits.medical_history: Fear of spiders since childhood; has not received psychotherapy before; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense but highly cooperative; clear expression, strong logic; able to engage in self-reflection and joint exploration

basic_info.main_problem: Fear of spiders causes significant distress, markedly worse in recent months especially in front of the girlfriend; often involves racing heart, sweating, trembling, and strong avoidance; more likely at home and outdoors; believed to stem from a childhood incident of a spider crawling on the body.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to reduce the impact of spider fear on the relationship with the girlfriend and overall mental health; hoping to understand why one reacts this way and to feel more hopeful that it can be managed.
growth_experiences: A specific childhood incident of a spider crawling on the body triggered a strong fear response; has feared spiders ever since, but it was not as severe in the past as now, with marked worsening in recent months.
Family-of-origin background: both parents serve in the military.

core_beliefs: I am cowardly (trapped by the 'wimp/cowardly' label)
I cannot control my fear and thoughts

special_situations.event: Sees a spider at home or thinks a spider might appear at home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot control my fear, spiders will crawl on me or bite me; I will lose control and get hurt
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately flees the scene, avoids corners of the home or places where there may be spiders
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A spider will crawl on me or bite me; I must leave immediately

special_situations.event: Noticing areas where spiders may appear during outdoor activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go to these places, I will inevitably encounter spiders and trigger intense panic, making me look very cowardly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or avoids outdoor activities; chooses 'safe zones'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once there, I will encounter spiders; things will be terrible

special_situations.event: Talking about or encountering spiders in front of the girlfriend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show fear, it means I am cowardly; she will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to hide the fear or avoid situations involving spiders in front of the girlfriend

special_situations.event: Conducts self-exposure training with spider pictures alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If anxiety cannot be reduced immediately, it shows exposure therapy has no effect; I cannot do it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly stops or interrupts practice, doubting the point of continuing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This may be of no use at all; I cannot do it

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be understood and accepted by the partner, not defined as 'cowardly', and to be seen as dependable and respectable
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being looked down on by the partner because of the fear response, being labeled negatively, thus causing relationship tension or damage
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of shame and evaluation by avoiding spider-related situations
Striving to control external reactions to maintain my self-image in front of my partner

object_relations.self_representation: A self that easily loses control and appears weak in front of others
object_relations.object_representation: A partner/significant other who may not understand and be judgmental

manifestations: Fear limits free activities at home and outdoors, leading to avoidance of various environments
In intimate relationships, feels restricted due to fear responses; self-image is constrained
outcomes: Decreased quality of life (difficulty relaxing at home, limited outdoor activities)
Relationship tension and impaired sense of self-worth

positive_force: Partner and friends are generally supportive (though they do not fully understand)
Work functioning intact, occupational role stable (pilot)
Willing to try different methods and able to propose more balanced alternative thoughts
Has proactively tried self-exposure training, with some motivation to change
negative_force: When encountering spiders, strong physiological and emotional reactions (racing heart, sweating, trembling)
Pervasive avoidance and catastrophizing/predicting-the-future cognitive patterns
In intimate relationships, tends toward mind reading and self-labeling ('cowardly')
Hasty negating of the methods' effectiveness and black-and-white thinking (considering them ineffective if they do not bring immediate relief)

target_behavior.behavior: Intense fear and panic reaction toward spiders (fleeing, avoiding)
antecedent: When seeing or thinking of possible spiders at home
Encountering outdoor areas that may have spiders
When viewing spider pictures for self-exposure
Talking about or encountering spiders when the girlfriend is present
target_behavior.core_reason: The childhood incident of a spider crawling on the body formed a conditioned fear; accompanied by cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, and mind reading, intensifying worries about harm and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoids stimuli regarded as dangerous in order to seek safety, while avoiding embarrassment and negative evaluation in front of the partner
target_behavior.consequence: Widespread avoidance restricts relaxation at home and outdoor activities; the relationship with the partner becomes strained; the overall psychological burden increases
